description: GENERIC Delta Inverter 600VA WZ 600 (40-60V DC to 230V AC) - Distributed/Packaged by Generic. Product Details: Description The Delta Inverter is a compact and uninterruptable single phase inverter. It provides an uninterruptible, stabilized AC voltage converted from DC battery systems. The overload capability enables the inverter to deliver high start up currents. Installation is simplified as all Delta inverters have their easy mount connectors. Modular UPS configurations can be realized in combination with Delta rectifier systems with battery backup and bypass. Main features Compact in design Pure sine wave output Very low output voltage distortion Bypass operation with relay Applications Inverter is suitably designed to use for Backup AC power LTE/4G stations Wireless applications
